catalog_quirks.body: Inferbase Free needs no card. The shared account allowance is 5,000 requests/month, also capped at 100 managed requests and $0.50 of model usage/day. Free managed chat permits 8,192 input and 1,024 output tokens per request. Counts are shared, not per-model grants. Model IDs including FP8 and Turbo variants are explicit; a changed response identity fails rather than silently substituting another model. Update FreeLLMAPI to a build with the Inferbase adapter. See https://inferbase.ai/pricing.
